description: Earnings data in two modes. 'history': a symbol's past quarters — actual vs. estimate EPS, surprise %, period (the surprise is the market-moving signal, surfaced prominently); requires `symbol`. 'calendar': upcoming releases in a date window — date, EPS/revenue estimates, symbol; uses `from`/`to` and optionally filters by `symbol`. Resolve a company name with finnhub_search_symbols first.

from.description: Calendar mode: window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when omitted.

limit.description: Max rows returned (history quarters or calendar entries). Default 50.

mode.description: 'history' = one symbol's past quarters with actual-vs-estimate surprises (requires `symbol`). 'calendar' = upcoming releases in a date window, optionally filtered by `symbol` (uses `from`/`to`).

symbol.description: Required for `history`; optionally filters `calendar` mode. US ticker. Resolve a name with finnhub_search_symbols first.

to.description: Calendar mode: window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today + 14 days when omitted.

name: finnhub_get_earnings

calendar.description: Present in `calendar` mode. Sorted by date. Note: `epsActual` and `revenueActual` are not surfaced here — this tool is for the upcoming-releases workflow; actuals are available in `history` mode for a specific symbol.

epsEstimate.description: Consensus EPS estimate. Null for distant future dates or uncovered symbols.

revenueEstimate.description: Consensus revenue estimate in the reporting currency. Null when unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_symbol`: mode 'history' was requested without a symbol. `not_us_or_paid`: Upstream HTTP 403 on the symbol. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

history.description: Present in `history` mode. Newest quarter first.

actualEPS.description: Reported EPS. Null if not yet reported.

surprisePercent.description: Surprise as % of estimate — the market-moving signal. Positive = beat, negative = miss.

notice.description: Guidance when the result set is empty.

totalCount.description: Total rows available before the limit.

truncated.description: True when rows were capped at the limit.

title: Finnhub Get Earnings
